query: 反歧视政策 反歧视政策 衡量企业在招聘、晋升、薪酬及日常管理中，针对消除基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等特征歧视的承诺、规则与执行机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：明确界定了受保护的多元特征（包含但不限于性别、民族、生理状况等）；且规定了面向全员的反歧视/DEI 专项培训要求。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的反歧视声明或包含在员工手册中，具备基础的公平雇佣承诺。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“依法合规雇佣”表述。 二、执行机制得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：具备匿名举报热线；有明确的违规调查处理流程。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：缺乏明确的举报渠道或未说明处理机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：未采取实质性的合规管理行动。 反歧视政策 禁止就业歧视 受保护特征 公平雇佣声明 反歧视培训 无意识偏见培训 歧视投诉 歧视调查处理 多元与共融 anti-discrimination policy non-discrimination in employment protected characteristics equal employment opportunity employment discrimination anti-discrimination training unconscious bias training discrimination complaint discrimination investigation diversity and inclusion 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反歧视政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法合规雇佣”口号；仅有多元化人数统计而无政策；仅有客户反歧视营销政策；仅有反骚扰但完全不涉及雇佣歧视时可谨慎区分；区分：反歧视政策关注禁止基于特定特征的歧视及合规执行；平等机会措施关注选拔流程公平与监控指标；员工申诉机制是通用渠道， alone 不能证明存在反歧视政策。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group strives to create an equal and inclusive working environment free of discrimination or harassment. We have zero tolerance for any form of discrimination on the grounds of age, gender, race or religion. We also prohibit all unfair and discriminating employment practices. In order to maintain a diversified workplace, a Board Diversity Policy is in place to assess the Board composition under diversified perspectives including gender, age, cultural and educational background and professional experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we continue to provide equal opportunity in all aspects to all employees and ensure that labour practices followed are fair and ethical, and respect the fundamental human rights of all employees.

The Group strives to create an equal and inclusive working environment free of discrimination or harassment. We have zero tolerance for any form of discrimination on the grounds of age, gender, race or religion. We also prohibit all unfair and discriminating employment practices. In order to maintain a diversified workplace, a Board Diversity Policy is in place to assess the Board composition under diversified perspectives including gender, age, cultural and educational background and professional experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we continue to provide equal opportunity in all aspects to all employees and ensure that labour practices followed are fair and ethical, and respect the fundamental human rights of all employees.

results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

results.text: To inspire employees to acquire new knowledge and keep abreast of the latest trends in the logistics industry, we encourage employees to participate in external training programmes based on their job needs and promote a comprehensive learning environment in the workplace.
